findings.reasoningSummary: MEDIUM deliberation chosen following R46 open gap. Source 145/input 109 unchanged, core/learner/AST/Config/initial 0.5/typed source/order/guards/controller/history/Cost unchanged. Eight frozen bijections realized by inverse vocabulary to original R35 runtime across 56 grounded 8-token sources, no monkeypatch/host semantic repair. 160 base cases across capacities n in {1,2,3,4} (40 per capacity: 24 Part I ASTxmask, 8 Part II multi-solution/query regimes, 8 Part III complete=False) achieve 8/8 distinct restricted maps (0 unchanged pairs, 1120 changed pairs), 64/64 ordered code pairs per codebook, and 6/6 distinct AST functions per capacity. Invalid maps and collapsed coverage reject; authored encoding not learner.

Each role Program/drive input/cfg/initial and all physical refs/full scalar/controller/Cost/source proof/slot/revision/final consumer checked. 64 numeric role inputs partition into 4 exact Hamming equivalence classes d in {0,1,2,3} (max within-class spread 1.0408340855860843e-17); 40320 bijections/2580480 saved lookups/0 wrong at role stage. 384 expr settles exhaust all 6x4^3 Hamming triples (384/384 correct, 15482880 bijection-class checks with 0 wrong). 60 feasible1..4 (60/60) and 680 query1..4 (680/680) extremal envelope settles verify capacity-stratified [false_max, true_min] boundary intervals without claiming 64^n enumeration. Full pipeline 1280 native/160 exact and 1120 paired conditions/1120 invariant, finite adoption=true; isometric 320/320 state_sha256 equal vs non-isometric 648/800 state_sha256 changed; 100% of upper tick differences confined to role_ticks while expr/feasible/query ticks are invariant (true). Max scalar error 1.1102230246251565e-16; 25/25 mutations rejected.

29404 actual settles/915408 ticks/80.51602940101293s within 240s stage/600s total, worker 1/retry 0. Preparation and work stages exited with returncode 0 (all 29404 settles and 1440 evaluations completed); audit stage exited 1 due only to KeyError('base_n') in r35_compositional_slot/verify.py line 53 return dict after all trace/drive/contract checks passed, reproduced and verified in local saved-data replay without modifying frozen code or rerunning server. Full source(56)/transfer(1188, including 64 role)/upper(28160) call ledger, bounded aggregate cache 128MiB/raw 128MiB/AS 512MiB each/record 128KiB/unique 2360<6000. Complete computed kernel+Config bytes confirm storage-only dedup; all calculations run. All phase CPU+parent seal+launcher measured=80.619944626; core/storage/source/transfer subset times not double added; no efficiency adoption gate or posthoc performance claim. All 2405 non-empty files + manifest directly match original manifest size/SHA; 5 empty logs/ZIP not received, manifest outside own hash/upstream unknown/same-channel not attestation. Author CS review is not independent audit.
